lhs: Concatenate converted operands along a shared logical axis, then bitcast-convert back to the original word type.
rhs: Concatenate the original operands in their original order along that axis.
conditions: Nonempty ordered operand list; arbitrary shared static prefix/suffix shapes and per-operand concat-axis extents; equal bit widths or integral ratio k > 1. Rank-changing conversions use the final lane axis, disjoint from concat. One consistent least-first or most-first order. Covers zero extents.
types: Positive-width raw BitVec words or a complete trailing axis of k narrow words; arbitrary payload including sign bits. Exact logical bit observation; no physical-layout or implementation-level claim.
overlap: BitPackingProof.repack_compose/repack_refl and BitPackingShapeProof split/join are inherited inverse results without intervening concatenation. Ordered many-operand concatenation and all three width directions are one mathematical case; the caller delegates directly.
